rows.label: Project
rows.value: Hazel Piling Encapsulation and Float Replacement

rows.label: What the project is
rows.value: 2025 - Retrofit an existing pier in Friday Harbor by encapsulating 3 creosote pilings and replacing an 8’x40’ float. The purpose of this project is to extend the lifespan of the 3 creosote pilings and replace an aging float that complies with current standards for light penetration. The 3 identified pilings would be sleeved with a 16” DR17 HDPE pipe, and the remaining void space filled with Simpson Strong-Tie FX-225 non-shrinking underwater grout. The float itself would be assembled at the contractor’s shop and be comprised of “100% grated surface to meet current light-penetration standards”.
